method: Raw450x400 sources composited without resampling into fixed142x136 crop(130,146,272,282), same crop for all8 cohorts and all actions. Each all-frame board viewed through lossless part1/part2 sheets below2048px. No independent per-frame bbox fitting. Separate paired identity and six-phase foot guide sheets viewed at1x. Large initial all-frame displays resized by the viewer were followed by these native1x parts.

observations.anatomy: All8 show coherent opaque adult human head/torso, two articulated arms and two legs; hands remain attached to held kit in inspected rows. No observed missing limb, enormous head, body clipping at raw canvas edge or transparent foot. Tiny fingers/face detail cannot be approved from native pixels.
observations.casting: Lunari groups30/31/32 show raising/reaching/retracting hands at three elevations with staff retained. No free spell/targeting claim is made.
observations.materials: Ivory wool/tunic, dark leather boots, brown shafts and warm bronze highlights remain readable; Lunari violet robes and silver/cyan accents distinguish support family. Painted surface quality and cloth weight remain final visual-review work. No generic smoothness metric substitutes for this judgment.
observations.melee_and_directions: Groups11/12/13 show different upper/level/lower hand and weapon elevations with visible preparation/extension/recovery. Forger polearm makes a large raised-to-contact arc; Rakkor thrusts are shorter; archers use compact secondary contact. These are visibly different poses, not JSON-only claims.
observations.shooting: Both final archer carry cohorts show attached compact bows through walk/hold and aim/draw/release/recovery in groups14/15/16. Upper, level and lower aims have visibly different arm/arrow heights. Actual projectile position, one-based climax timing, both engine facings and release event remain unobserved.
observations.turn_hit_defence_death: Turn rows change body/weapon orientation, hit/defence shift torso/arms, death progresses from standing to a ground-oriented horizontal corpse. Death is rather stiff through the torso and could merit later motion polish, but the inspected final pose reads as dead. Runtime pacing and corpse/shadow overlap were not tested.
observations.upgrades: Rakkor upgrade visibly adds cap, broader patterned shield and bronze chest/shoulder forms. Marksman adds shoulder protection and a reinforced bow, although its lower-body silhouette stays close to base. Lunari upgrade remains insufficiently distinct beyond head crescent. Solar upgrade adds torso gold forms but underlying family remains too close to light tunic infantry for the documented heavy role.
observations.walk_and_root: All six phases show alternating leg spread/passing/support and small torso motion around consistent foot area; sources are not rigid translations of one still. Fixed y267 guide shows support soles at or near a shared baseline, without per-frame whole-body scale changes. Contact sheets cannot establish engine registration, sliding under the movement clock or generated shadows.

rule_quotes.quote: Upgrades need a clearly larger visual gap: better armour coverage/materials, differentiated weapons, headgear, silhouette, posture and restrained heraldry where appropriate.
Differentiate light pass infantry, sustained bow fire, compact horned ground beast, robe/tool support, agile bird, broad heavy forge fighter and large winged celestial animal.
